scope: Read-only primary upstream documentation and source review

findings.finding: Emulator image build selects x86_64 Google APIs system images. Native Linux ARM64 support is not demonstrated by the inspected upstream path; registry platform manifests were not inspected.
Launcher raises when /dev/kvm is absent, before invoking emulator; default CPU acceleration is on.
SwiftShader is graphics software rendering, separate from VM/CPU acceleration. swiftshader_indirect is deprecated in current Android documentation.
Current Android CLI documentation lists -no-accel as deprecated, potentially ignored or rejected depending on emulator version.
EMULATOR_ADDITIONAL_ARGS passes options but does not skip the earlier KVM existence check. No supported no-KVM launch identified.
An ARM VM without KVM is not a supported drop-in for the inspected unmodified budtmo path. No boot was attempted; alternative native ARM/emulation solution requires separate evidence and measurement.
MongoDB is required; README recommends 6.0. PostgreSQL/Redis do not replace it.
Hub needs MongoDB and at least one Provider for devices. Hub embeds Appium grid, so external Selenium Grid is optional.
Provider adopts already-running Android emulators via adb; it does not boot or stop AVDs. Provider emulator support must be enabled.
Container-hosted ADB visibility, emulator identity, streaming, and Appium routing have not been validated end to end.

decision: Do not present Oracle ARM/no-KVM plus unmodified budtmo as a validated free emulator route.
